page.overview:
Who is Ali'ane?

Ali'ane was a female Lupr'or who lived in her home on the planet Luprora. They had a great granddaughter who wore a necklace salvaged from a Lupr'or starship. Shortly after the Battle of Starkiller Base, Ali'ane's great granddaughter visited them with Captain Phasma, TN-3465, and Dar'en to speak about a necklace.

Ali'ane was the oldest living Lupr'or by the time of the Battle of Starkiller Base in 34 ABY. They were born in the stars. They gave a necklace salvaged from a Lupr'or starship to their great granddaughter. During the hunt for the First Order fugitive Sol Rivas, Captain Phasma questioned Ali'ane and their great granddaughter about where they had acquired the necklace from.

Regarding technology as evil, Ali'ane refused to reveal the location of the last Lupr'or starship, claiming that it came from the "old world". At Phasma's prompting, Ali'ane's great granddaughter claimed that Phasma had been sent by the gods to save them from the R'ora and the Tsw'ells. Ali'ane responded that the ancestors had forbidden technology, which descried as the soul killer.

Despite Ali'ane's efforts, their great granddaughter secretly revealed the location of the Lupr'or starship to Phasma. This allowed her to obtain generators which the Lupr'or used to electrocute the tsw'ells in the lake surrounding the R'ora stronghold.
